title: DOE/NNSA RFP 89233220RNA000002 (Y-12 and Pantex M&O) — Section L, pages 5-10
labelled_by: Claude (AI-assisted), line by line against the parser output; independent human review pending
notes: Real federal solicitation (US Government work, public domain), Amendment 0004, 2021. Excerpt of PDF pages 5-10: general proposal preparation instructions, page limits, formatting, and Volume I contents. Page numbers are the PDF's.

requirements.quote: entity must be incorporated or otherwise legally established before proposal submission
The Offeror shall not submit the information required at Sections L-9(c), L-9(d), and L-10 (a), Criterion 1, Past Performance, for team members with a proposed work scope less than $10 million
No classified information shall be included in this solicitation or in the Offeror’s proposal
Questions or comments regarding this solicitation shall be submitted via email to: SEB8@nnsa.doe.gov
no later than 2:00pm EST November 23, 2020
Offeror shall utilize Times New Roman, 12pt font, and provide in Microsoft® Word format
Only potential Offerors that submit an intent to bid in accordance with L-29 below will be granted access to this reading room information
Submission of final proposal revisions (FPRs) shall consist of new and complete Volumes I, II, and III
Offerors shall submit “clean” copies of Volumes I, II and III along with “line-in/line-out” versions
The following edit feature settings shall be applied: inserted text--red and underlined; deleted text--struck through in black
A vertical bar in the left margin shall be applied for changed lines
All changes and additional documentation provided within a particular Volume shall be documented via cover page crosswalk
Proposals shall be electronically submitted via FedConnect at https://www.fedconnect.net
Proposals shall be structured in three separate volumes
Volume I – The Offer - One (1) signed original
Volume II – Technical and Management Information – One (1) original
Volume III – Cost Information – One (1) original
each file must clearly identify the Volume number and the sequence to which it relates
Each volume shall include the Offeror’s point of contact (name and telephone number)
the team member shall share the password with the Contracting Officer via e-mail to SEB8@nnsa.doe.gov
Team member submissions must adhere to the proposal due date/time
Each volume shall contain a glossary of all abbreviations and acronyms used
A Transmittal Letter shall be limited to one (1) page
The Technical and Management Information (Volume II) shall not exceed 25 pages
Material may not be incorporated by reference in Volume II (including any information in Volume I or III) as a means to circumvent the page limitations
Resumes of Key Personnel, which are limited to five (5) pages each
except for the CEO or President’s resume, which is limited to seven (7) pages
UPF Interface Management Approach, limited to ten (10) pages
limited to eight (8) pages per PPIF
This information shall be submitted as an Addendum to Volume II and shall not exceed eight (8) pages
All pages shall be 8.5 x 11 inches
Text contained in all volumes shall be in Times New Roman text no smaller than size 12 font
all text, including in graphics, shall be single spaced
the font used shall be clearly legible and no smaller than size 8
Page margins shall be a minimum of one inch at the top, bottom, and each side
all pages of each Volume shall be appropriately numbered, identified with the name of the Offeror, the date, the solicitation number, and a legend
Page numbers shall be sequential by Volume
No information, other than what is referred to in this ¶ (e)(3), shall appear in the page margins
Offerors shall ensure that tables, diagrams, charts and/or other graphic illustrations are word-searchable
The Offeror shall provide the administrative information
Offerors must submit one (1) original signed copy of the SF 33 document
The person signing the SF 33 must have the authority to commit the Offeror
In Block 14 of each SF 33, the Offeror must acknowledge receipt of all amendments
Any exceptions or deviations by the Offeror to the terms and conditions stated in this solicitation
The Offeror shall submit a fully completed Section K, Representations, Certifications, and Other Statements of Offerors
Each team member shall separately complete, sign, and submit the Section K
The Offeror shall complete and submit Section L, Attachment I - Offeror Information
submit a copy of their FAR Report under the Representations and Certifications from the System for Award Management (SAM)
The Offeror and each team member shall submit the Organizational Conflict of Interest (OCI) requirement in Section K
The Offeror and each team member shall submit a copy of its Assertions from the SAM
shall submit required representation, and additional disclosures (if applicable) as set forth under FAR 52.204-25
The Offeror shall submit a fully completed and executed Performance Guarantee Agreement(s)
The Offeror shall submit the last three annual reports (i.e. business reports) for the parent organization(s)
The Offeror shall submit evidence that the “the legal entity submitting the offer” is legally established
The Offeror shall submit a Small Business Subcontracting Plan for Government fiscal year 2021 through 2031
Offerors are prohibited from submitting multiple offers/proposals as a prime contractor or parent company
